assertions.name: c_2/c_0 = (N-Z)^2/2 + (5-A)/8 exactly, for every A = 3..10 and every Z
the additive L's type-2 piece is LINEAR in Z — no quadratic term survives the logarithm
the all-pairs coefficient is C(A/2,2), growing like A^2/8 — further from the 1/A the SEMF needs than the chain's constant 1/2
the volume-like coefficient is more than an order of magnitude below SEMF's
the asymmetry term is A-independent, so it cannot match SEMF's 1/A at more than one mass number

description: The (N-Z)^2 asymmetry term lives at Vassiliev type two. For the chain trace written as a product of bond factors, c_2/c_0 = (N-Z)^2/2 + (5-A)/8 exactly, verified symbolically for every A = 3..10 and every Z. The mechanism is that the type-2 coefficient of a product contains sum_{i<j} f_i' f_j', a sum over PAIRS of bonds, quadratic in the bond counts; taking -log turns the product into a sum and removes exactly that term, which is why the resummed L is additive, linear in Z, and has no valley of stability. Read as -alpha c_2/c_0 this gives a volume-like term linear in A and an asymmetry term quadratic in N-Z, both with the SEMF's sign and functional form. Magnitudes are wrong (volume 0.52 vs 15.8 MeV/nucleon) and the asymmetry lacks the 1/A. The all-pairs factor product is also exactly quadratic but with coefficient C(A/2,2), which is worse. Compare qou-xwur, where the partition route gave only log[2T+1]_q. No binding number, no fit, nothing wired. Bean qou-oooq.
caveats: Shape result only. No binding number is produced, nothing is fitted or wired, and the sign convention (binding as -c_2 rather than +c_2) is assumed rather than derived: c_2/c_0 is MINIMISED at N = Z.
The all-pairs case uses the naive factor product, not the true all-pairs trace, which qou-bygw showed is not well defined until a bond ordering is fixed. That ambiguity is untouched here.
Does not show that the LP/SDP per-type reading of vassiliev-filtration-mass-tower is the correct one. If the framework resums, the logarithm returns and so does the obstruction.
